name: How long does tankless water heater maintenance take?

mainEntity.name: How long does tankless water heater maintenance take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard tankless water heater maintenance service typically takes about 1 to 2 hours. This timeframe allows our technicians to thoroughly flush the system, descale the heat exchanger, and perform a comprehensive inspection of all components. The exact duration can vary slightly depending on the unit's condition and the extent of mineral buildup.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard maintenance usually takes 1 to 2 hours, allowing for thorough flushing, descaling, and inspection of the unit.
